episodes.instruction: Grab the can with red body and put it in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips, then lift the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Use the left arm to set the can with shiny smooth surface in the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips; another arm lifts the yellow rectangular basket with dual grips.
Grab the rounded can with smooth printed surface and put it in the oval basket with medium storage space, then lift the oval basket with medium storage space.
